text:
jen: Rolling inference-proxy from 2.4.1 -> 2.4.2 in eu-west-1. Change window now (20:30-21:30). Starting staggered canaries (5). Will watch health + synthetic probes. @sam @priya please stand by.

deploy-bot: rollout rl-2023456780 started · canary 1/5 ✅ started · strategy=staggered · probes=kv-synth, http-health
sam: saw a KV-synth 504 on canary-3, small burst at 20:34 :warning:
priya: copying logs from canary-3, looks like upstream connection timeout to backend-cache: 
```
ERROR inference-proxy backend fetch failed: dial tcp 10.12.5.8:11211: i/o timeout
at proxy/cache.go:142
```

tomas: quick check — canary pod list:
```
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=inference-proxy -o wide
# canary-1 Running
# canary-2 Running
# canary-3 CrashLoopBackOff (restarted 2x)
# canary-4 Running
# canary-5 Running
```
jen: hmm. canary-3 restart seems to correlate with a transient memcached flake in eu-west-1 around 20:33. Probe timeout is 3s currently. Propose bumping probe timeout to 7s for this rollout and pin traffic for tenant alpha to 2.4.1 until we confirm. Thoughts? :eyes:
sam: agree with pin for alpha. if we bump probe timeout we should also extend rollout window by 15m.
priya: I can push the probe delta now and watch metrics. will also add a temporary circuit to bypass cache for canary-3 while it stabilizes.
priya: command I'm going to run:
```
redwood rollout update rl-2023456780 --probe-timeout=7000
redwood route pin inference-proxy tenant=alpha --revision=2.4.1 --duration=30m
```
tomas: :thumbsup: runbook check — if canary-3 keeps CrashLoopBackOff for >3 restarts in 10m we rollback.
deploy-bot: rollout update applied · probe-timeout=7000ms · pinned routes: inference-proxy@alpha -> 2.4.1 (30m)
jen: monitoring dash up — kv-synth latency back to normal for 4/5 canaries. canary-3 showing slower restarts but no new 504s after probe change. hold for another 10m then decide.
sam: quick synthetic: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" http://canary-2.local/health` -> `200 0.12s` :white_check_mark:
priya: keeping cache bypass on canary-3 for now. I'll remove bypass if stable after 15m.
jen: thanks all. plan: keep pin for 30m, extend change window +15m, unpin if no regressions. if canary-3 degrades again we rollback to 2.4.1.
deploy-bot: rollout status: 4/5 canaries healthy · 1 degraded (watching) · autoscaler bumped to preserve headroom
jen: noted. I'll update release notes with the temporary probe tweak and the pin decision. follow-up in 20m.
